ITA-5.65.8 bhraṃśathuḥ भ्रंशथुः
Thick saltish nasal discharge
A disorder characterized by excessive secretion of viscid dense mucus; excessive undigested sour secretion; excessive salty mucus discharge.

.5 bhrājakapittam भ्राजकपित्तम्
Pitta for complexion
Subtype of pitta seated in the skin which is responsible for its glossiness or lustre.

bhrāmaram भ्रामरम्
Whitish honey from large bees
A variety of whitish-coloured honey produced by large black bees.
